title: Experimental, punk, and independent scenes
centralClaim: Challenging established musical norms through experimentation, DIY ethics, and a rejection of mainstream commercialism.
whyItMatters: This movement fostered radical artistic expression, democratized music production, and profoundly influenced subsequent genres by prioritizing authenticity over polish.

contributors.name: John Cage
contributors.reason: His experimental approach to composition fundamentally altered musical conventions and inspired generations of artists.

contributors.name: Patti Smith
contributors.reason: Bridged punk rock and poetry, establishing a vital artistic voice for the independent scene.

contributors.name: Nirvana
contributors.reason: Brought alternative and independent music to a mainstream audience, impacting youth culture globally.

objections: Can be overly broad, encompassing diverse and sometimes conflicting aesthetics.
Risk of romanticizing DIY ethos without acknowledging its limitations.
Defining boundaries between 'experimental' and mainstream rock can be subjective.
Some subgenres within the scene may have been more commercially successful than others.
